West Bengal Government Forms Panel for Uniform Civil Code

The West Bengal government has established a committee to assist with the rollout of a Uniform Civil Code (UCC). This move positions West Bengal to potentially become the fourth state to adopt such legislation. The panel is reportedly tasked with formulating the UCC bill, with a timeline suggesting legislation could be introduced in August.
